tests.name: QA-01 creates and edits a profile with persisted grants and stable identity
QA-02 grants, replaces and clears permissions for every user of a profile using existing sessions
QA-03 moves a user between profiles through HTTP and immediately applies the new grants
QA-04 blocks and unblocks login and existing sessions without changing credentials, profile or peer access
QA-05 POST /api/roles requires exactly roles.create and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 PUT /api/roles/:role requires exactly roles.update and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 GET /api/roles/:role requires exactly roles.read and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 GET /api/roles/:role/permissions requires exactly roles.read and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 GET /api/permissions requires exactly permissions.read and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 PUT /api/roles/:role/permissions requires exactly roles.permissions.update and denies unauthorized changes
QA-05 PATCH /api/users/:user/access requires exactly users.update and denies unauthorized changes
QA-06 rejects privilege escalation and self-unblocking by a blocked user without side effects
QA-07 rejects invalid grants atomically and keeps existing sessions authorized: {"permissions":["users.read","unknown.permission"]}
QA-07 rejects invalid grants atomically and keeps existing sessions authorized: {"permissions":["users.read","users.read"]}
QA-07 rejects invalid grants atomically and keeps existing sessions authorized: {"permissions":null}
QA-08 rejects duplicate profile names on creation and editing without losing grants
